title: Dunder Mifflin OS webhook event
description: The body of POST /api/ingest/:agentId. One event per request. Unknown fields are refused. Free text is scrubbed of tokens, chat ids, phone numbers and home paths before it reaches the browser.

name.description: How the agent is called on the map (a temp's name, or the persona shown under a character).

role.description: What the agent does, shown in its window.

at.description: When it happened (ISO 8601). Default: when the server received it. Times in the future count as now.

room.description: A room id on the map, e.g. ops (Conference Room) or council.

oneOf.title: status
oneOf.description: The agent's status. A meeting status with a room draws the agent in that room.

activity.description: What it is doing (or waiting on), shown in the chip above the character.

oneOf.title: activity
oneOf.description: What the agent is doing now. Marks it working.

oneOf.title: task
oneOf.description: Creates or updates one of the agent's tasks (by id). Shared tasks show in the Ops room.

oneOf.title: message
oneOf.description: A message from the agent, shown in its direct line (the chat in its window).

oneOf.title: approval
oneOf.description: The agent is waiting on you: it shows in the approvals inbox (Toby's desk) and the agent is shown as needing you. With a callback, Approve/Reject POST the decision there (see webhook.md); without one, the item is shown only. Sending the same id again replaces it.

id.description: The agent's own id for this request; the decision quotes it.

title.description: What it wants, as a question or an action: "Deploy v1.2 to production?"

detail.description: Why, or the exact command or change. Several lines are fine.

risk.description: How much damage saying yes could do. Default: medium.

callback.description: Where the office POSTs your decision: an https URL, or http on 127.0.0.1/localhost. No credentials in the URL.

oneOf.title: approval-withdrawn
oneOf.description: The agent no longer waits for this request (answered elsewhere, timed out): it leaves the inbox.

oneOf.title: controls
oneOf.description: Lets the office pause, resume and stop this agent: it POSTs signed control events to the callback (see webhook.md). Send it again to change the verbs; verbs [] withdraws them. Without one, the agent can't be paused or stopped from the office.

verbs.description: What the office may do: pause (and resume) and/or stop.

callback.description: Where the office POSTs control events: an https URL, or http on 127.0.0.1/localhost. No credentials in the URL. Required with verbs.
